use: A compact breathing mask with a small compressed air supply, the emergency breather provides 10 minutes of breathable atmosphere. name: Atmosphere Processor (Portable)

It requires an enclosed space to function effectively, a ship compartment, sealed tent, or natural cave.
tactical: Essential for long-term survival in environments with unbreathable but not immediately lethal atmospheres. The processor can also extend life support on a damaged ship by recycling air more efficiently than biological respiration alone.

The material is transparent, allowing observation of surroundings.
tactical: Emergency survival in decompression events, hull breaches, or hostile atmosphere exposure. The shelter is not mobile, occupants must wait for rescue or until conditions improve. It's also useful for creating a clean medical environment in contaminated areas.

name: Thermal Regulation Suit (TRS)
use: Temperature Range: -50°C to 70°C. A lightweight bodysuit with active temperature regulation, the TRS maintains comfortable body temperature across a wide range of environmental conditions. The suit uses a combination of insulation, heat pumps, and evaporative cooling to manage heat exchange with the environment. It does not provide significant physical protection, it's survival gear, not armor.
tactical: Standard wear for operations on worlds with extreme temperatures. The TRS can be worn under armor, providing its thermal protection in addition to the armor's other benefits.

name: Rad-Suit
use: Protection: Complete radiation shielding · Duration: 12 hours of continuous exposure. A sealed suit with integrated radiation shielding, the rad-suit allows operation in environments with dangerous radiation levels, reactor accidents, fallout zones, certain stellar phenomena. The suit includes a filtered breathing system and limited thermal regulation. After 12 hours of exposure, the shielding becomes saturated and must be replaced or allowed to decay (approximately 1 week).
tactical: Essential for exploring contaminated sites, salvaging from damaged reactors, or operating near unshielded energy sources. The suit is bulky and limits mobility but provides complete protection within its rating.

name: Hostile Environment Suit (HES)
use: Protection: Vacuum, toxic atmosphere, radiation, temperature (-100°C to 150°C) · Life Support: 48 hours · Armor Equivalent: Light armor (4/10 Thresholds, Armor Slots 3). The hostile environment suit is a comprehensive survival system designed for the most dangerous environments, planetary surfaces with no atmosphere, extreme radiation, or temperatures that would destroy conventional equipment. The suit is fully sealed with redundant life support, integrated waste recycling, and radiation-hardened components. It provides light armor protection as a side benefit of its construction.
tactical: Required equipment for planetary exploration, salvage operations in extreme environments, or any situation where standard voidsuits are insufficient. The HES is the suit you wear when you expect the environment to actively try to kill you.

tactical: Emergency food supply for any operation. Crews typically maintain several weeks of ration packs as backup against supply disruption, even when better food is available.

name: Water Purifier (Personal)

The purifier handles biological contamination, most chemical pollutants, and particulate matter. It cannot process salt water (requires separate desalination attachment) or severely radioactive water (requires the heavy purifier model).
tactical: Essential survival equipment for planetary operations. Natural water sources are rarely safe to drink; the purifier removes the guesswork.

name: Water Reclaimer
use: Capacity: Supports 4 people indefinitely · Power: Requires external power. A closed-loop water recycling system that recovers moisture from all sources, respiration, perspiration, waste, and processes it back into potable water. The reclaimer requires power but no water input beyond what the users produce biologically. Efficiency is approximately 95%; the remaining 5% loss means the system works indefinitely only with occasional small water inputs.
tactical: Long-term survival in environments without accessible water. Essential equipment for any extended planetary operation or emergency survival situation.

name: Survival Rations (Premium)

tactical: Morale matters. Crews on long operations perform better with decent food. Premium rations are the compromise between "emergency survival" and "actual meals."

name: Survival Tent (Basic)

A lightweight portable shelter providing protection from weather, wind, and moderate temperature extremes. The tent is not sealed, it exchanges air with the environment, but it blocks wind, rain, and direct sunlight. Setup requires no tools and can be accomplished by one person.
tactical: Basic camping and emergency shelter. The tent keeps you dry and out of the wind, which is sufficient for many planetary environments.

name: Survival Tent (Environmental)

Integrated thermal regulation maintains comfortable temperatures, and the fabric includes radiation-resistant layers. The tent can operate unsealed in breathable atmospheres, functioning as an upgraded basic tent.
tactical: Base camp for hostile environment operations. The environmental tent allows crews to establish a livable space on worlds where outdoor exposure is dangerous.

The module can function as a permanent installation or be repackaged for relocation.

name: Electronic Bypass Kit
use: A set of tools for defeating electronic security, card cloners, code analyzers, bypass modules, and interface devices. The kit allows a skilled operator to defeat most commercial-grade electronic security.

name: Hacking Rig
use: A sophisticated computer system designed specifically for intrusion, processing power for cracking encryption, software for exploiting vulnerabilities, and interfaces for connecting to diverse systems. The hacking rig represents serious capability for serious intrusion.

name: Stealth Suit (Basic)
use: A suit designed to minimize the wearer's detectable signature, dark, non-reflective materials; thermal masking; and sound-dampening construction. The suit provides no armor protection but significantly improves stealth capability.

name: Identity Mask
use: An advanced mask that perfectly mimics another person's face. The mask uses synthetic materials that adjust to match a target's features based on recorded data or uploaded specifications. It also includes voice modulation to match the target's speech patterns.

name: Sensor Ghost
use: A device that generates a false sensor signature at a location up to Far range from the wearer. Security systems detect the ghost rather than the actual person. The device can generate signatures mimicking the wearer or pre-programmed patterns.

name: Restraints (Standard)
use: Basic restraints for securing prisoners, handcuffs, zip ties, or similar devices. Standard restraints are effective against unaugmented humans but can be defeated by sufficient strength or cybernetic enhancement.

name: Restraints (Reinforced)
use: Heavy-duty restraints designed for augmented subjects, reinforced construction, electronic locks, and optional shock deterrent. These restraints resist the enhanced strength that defeats standard restraints.

name: Neural Inhibitor
use: A device (usually a collar or implant) that limits or blocks neural activity, preventing the subject from taking voluntary actions. The inhibitor can be set to various levels, from mild sedation to complete paralysis.

name: Flashlight (Standard)
use: Duration: 24 hours. A simple light source. The standard flashlight is robust, long-lasting, and provides reliable illumination. While omni-tools include flashlight functions, dedicated flashlights are typically brighter and longer-lasting.

name: Glow-Sticks (Pack)
use: Duration: 8 hours each. Chemical light sources that require no power and function anywhere. Glow-sticks are useful for marking locations, creating ambient lighting, and providing light in environments where electronics fail.

name: Portable Lamp
use: Duration: 48 hours. A portable area light source for camps, workspaces, or emergency shelter. The lamp provides diffuse lighting suitable for reading, work, and general illumination rather than the focused beam of a flashlight.

name: Backpack (Standard)
use: Capacity: +4 Burden capacity. A standard carrying pack suitable for general use. The backpack distributes weight effectively and includes multiple compartments for organization.

name: Tactical Vest
use: Capacity: +2 Burden capacity. A vest with numerous pockets and attachment points for carrying essential items within easy reach. Unlike a backpack, items in a tactical vest can be accessed quickly.

name: Sealed Container
use: Capacity: 2 Burden. A waterproof, pressure-sealed, impact-resistant container for protecting sensitive equipment. The sealed container keeps contents safe from environmental hazards and rough handling.

name: Security Case
use: Capacity: 2 Burden. A hardened container with integrated security features, biometric lock, tamper detection, and optional destruction mechanism for contents if unauthorized access is attempted.

name: Clothing (Standard Set)
use: A basic set of clothing appropriate for general wear, the kind of thing that doesn't stand out or attract attention. Multiple sets in different styles allow characters to dress appropriately for various environments.

name: Formal Wear
use: High-quality formal clothing suitable for diplomatic functions, corporate meetings, and social events among the elite. Good formal wear signals wealth and status.

name: Disguise Kit
use: A collection of materials for altering appearance, makeup, prosthetics, wigs, colored contacts, and similar supplies. The kit allows significant changes to apparent age, gender, and features without technological assistance.

name: Rope (50m)
use: High-strength synthetic rope for climbing, restraining, hauling, and general utility. Modern rope materials provide strength far beyond natural fibers at a fraction of the weight.

name: Grappling Hook
use: A hook designed to anchor on surfaces for climbing or traversal. Modern grappling hooks include magnetic option for metal surfaces and expanding prongs for irregular surfaces.

name: Binoculars (Enhanced)
use: Optical magnification devices with stabilization, low-light enhancement, and range finding. Enhanced binoculars provide clear vision at distances far beyond natural human capability.

name: Fire Starting Kit
use: Materials and tools for starting fires in the field, ignition sources, tinder, and fire-starting chemicals. The kit works in adverse conditions where natural ignition would be difficult.

name: Personal Hygiene Kit
use: Basic hygiene supplies, soap, dental care, grooming tools, and similar necessities. Extended operations without hygiene maintenance create discomfort, social issues, and eventually health problems.

name: Entertainment Device
use: A personal entertainment device, games, media, reading, or whatever the character uses to relax.

name: Sensor Baffler
use: +4 to Agility Rolls to avoid electronic detection.

name: ID Mask
use: Facial restructuring device. Alters appearance completely.

name: Voice Modulator
use: Changes voice to any preset. Includes recording function.

name: Heartbeat Faker
use: Produces fake life signs. Defeats medical sensors.

name: Thought Shield
use: Blocks telepathic intrusion. +4 to Instinct Reaction Rolls against mental effects.

name: Null-Box
use: Faraday cage for small items. Contents undetectable by any scanner.

name: Berserker Chip
benefit: When activated, +2 to Strength Rolls and +2 flat melee damage for the scene; mark 1 Stress afterward. It never dictates movement. Addictive Interface risk.

use: Spend an Action and one dose on a stabilized target; it clears 3d8 HP, up to maximum. A patient benefits once per Long Rest.

name: Regeneration Serum
use: A stabilized target clears 1 HP after each complete minute for up to 1 hour. It cannot affect Dying or Final before stabilization.

name: Anti-Rad
use: Spend an Action and one dose to clear a radiation-defined Poisoned effect and gain Advantage on radiation Reaction Rolls for 24 hours.

name: Resuscitation Compound
use: Spend an Action and one dose on an adjacent Dying or Final target, then make Knowledge (Medicine), DC 20. On success, stabilize it at 1 HP and 3 Stress. On failure it remains in that state. One attempt per patient per scene. It cannot revive the dead or reverse a Death Move.

name: Universal Decryptor
use: +4 to Knowledge (Tech) Rolls against civilian encryption.

name: Military Decryptor

name: Ghost Box
use: Masks all electronic emissions. Device not exist.

name: Neural Hijacker
use: On contact, an augmented NPC makes a Presence Reaction Roll, DC 20; on failure the operator may direct one simple, non-self-destructive Action on its next Spotlight. Against a player character, failure causes Dazed instead unless that player consents to the directed Action.

name: AI Shackle-Breaker
use: Remove AI control limiters. Creates unshackled AI.

name: Through-Wall Scanner

name: Communication Interceptor

name: Thought Screen

name: Personality Imprinter
use: With a willing subject and 1 hour, Knowledge (Tech), DC 25, can install one temporary behavioral persona for a scene. Permanent identity change is a campaign event requiring the affected player's explicit consent.

name: Veil-Viewer
